text.content:
NARI-5 has one year left under a failing worldshield as CARMINE approaches death-bloom.

Rifts open across the neon city-planet and release demonic swarms. Player characters are wired outcasts hired to cull outbreaks, steal shield resources, and chase rumors of the Ark.

Tone: neon, maximalist, ferocious, sleek, desperate-but-defiant, techno. Themes: last pleasure, contracted violence, survival by theft.

daggerheartSpace.source: The New Unknown Playtest Volume 2.0 - Mind
